plan.archetype: Early AoE damage into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter near full health with efficient AoE, sustained damage, upgraded weak, and reliable block. Preserve useful potions for the followers’ combined pressure.
plan.summary: Prioritize immediate damage and AoE before slow scaling. Use ordinary fights for rewards and Fishing Rod upgrades. Add poison and dexterity, remove Strikes, and take elites selectively.

plan.archetype: AoE and poison scaling with dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter near full health with AoE for followers, sustained poison, reliable block, upgraded weak, and a useful potion.
plan.summary: Buy immediate AoE or efficient defense. Heal at the early campfire; reassess the elite after shop upgrades. Build poison and dexterity without bloating the deck.

plan.archetype: Group poison and sustained scaling behind dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with Haze+, Footwork+, reliable poison and block. Use Liquid Bronze against followers and multihits; upgrade Neutralize when safe.
plan.summary: Heal now and avoid remaining elites. Upgrade Haze at the next safe campfire. Add sustained poison or efficient AoE, maintain defensive density, and preserve health for the boss.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and discard cycling
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with accelerated poison, upgraded Footwork, efficient block, and defensive potions. Prepare for three-card limits, healing, and growing multihit attacks.
plan.summary: Use both shops to secure poison scaling and remove weak attacks. Preserve defensive density; upgrade core poison when Feather permits. Take only the late, campfire-supported elite.
